title: Shabbos of Emunah & Bitachon
body: Rabbi Sholom Mordechai Rubashkin hosts the 5th Annual Shabbos of Emunah & Bitachon at The Westin in Princeton, NJ, Feb 6-8, Parshas Yisro.

title: Maduro Faces US Judge
body: Senior Judge Alvin K. Hellerstein, an Orthodox Jew, will preside over the US case against Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro in Manhattan.
